mechanism: Moxifloxacin prolongs QT interval and rilpivirine also carries QT prolongation risk, creating additive cardiac effects; additionally, moxifloxacin may inhibit CYP3A4 leading to increased rilpivirine exposure.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, obtain baseline and periodic ECG monitoring, maintain electrolyte levels (especially potassium and magnesium), and consider alternative antibiotic with lower QT risk.
